events.title: Raiders knock
events.description: Fists bang on the hatch. "Open up! We just want food!"

options.label: Open the door
options.text: They take 2 food, but leave a medkit behind (+3 health).

options.label: Ignore them
options.text: They pry the hatch, grab 3 scrap and smash things.
options.unless_text: Your Reinforced Door holds. They give up and leave.

events.title: Radiation storm
events.description: The geiger counter screams. A storm is rolling in for tomorrow.

options.label: Hide
options.text: You will stay inside tomorrow.

options.label: Go out anyway
options.text: Radiation will build twice as fast tomorrow.

events.title: Pipe burst
events.description: Water sprays from a cracked pipe in the wall.

options.label: Repair it (3 scrap)
options.text: You patch the pipe with scrap.

options.label: Ignore it
options.text: You lose 2 water.

events.title: Stranger's radio message
events.description: A weak voice: "I left supplies out there for anyone still alive..."

options.label: Follow it
options.text: Tomorrow the crates out there hold extra supplies (+50% loot).

options.label: Ignore it
options.text: Could be a trap. You turn the radio off.

events.title: Rats in the pantry
events.description: Scratching in the dark. Something is eating your food.

options.label: Fight them
options.text: You chase them off, but get bitten (-1 health).

options.label: Let them eat
options.text: They eat 2 food.

events.title: Quiet night
events.description: For once, nothing happens. You sleep deeply.

options.label: Rest
options.text: You feel better (+2 health).

options.label: Rest some more
options.text: You feel better (+2 health).

events.title: A dented can
events.description: You find an old dented can behind the shelf. The lid bulges a little.

options.label: Eat it
options.text: It was bad. Your stomach cramps all night (-2 health, hunger eased).

options.label: Throw it away
options.text: Better safe than sorry.

events.title: Rain shower
events.description: Rain drums on the hatch. Water trickles down the shaft.

options.label: Set out buckets
options.text: You collect 3 dirty water. Filter or boil it before drinking.

options.label: Drink from the shaft
options.text: Cold and gritty, but your thirst is gone. Probably fine.

events.title: The trader rat
events.description: A scruffy old man with a pet rat knocks. "Scrap for food, friend?"

options.label: Trade (3 scrap)
options.text: He hands over 2 canned meals and a bandage.

options.label: Send him away
options.text: He shrugs and wanders off into the dark.

events.title: Something smells
events.description: The raw meat in the locker is turning green.

options.label: Eat it now
options.text: Not great, not terrible (+hunger, -1 health).

options.label: Throw it out
options.text: You toss the meat out of the hatch.

events.title: Mushrooms in the corner
events.description: Pale mushrooms sprouted in the damp corner of the bedroom.

options.label: Pick them
options.text: You pick 2 mushrooms for the Stove.

options.label: Leave them
options.text: They might be poisonous anyway.

events.title: The horde at the hatch
events.description: Dozens of the dead claw at the hatch. It won't hold long.

options.label: Hold the hatch
options.text: They break in, grab 2 meals and hurt you before you drive them out (-2 health).
options.unless_text: Your Reinforced Door holds. By dawn the horde drifts away.

options.label: Throw out 3 meals
options.text: They fight over the food and leave the hatch alone.
